title: Facing Pages
description: Twenty-eight projects in an English–Arabic book. Change the type size and the pages reflow; turn the spread to read from the other side.
signature: Measured CSS-column pagination, English/Arabic facing pages, and a 64-segment cylinder page curl captured from the actual DOM. A CSS 3D binding remains when graphics are unavailable.
holdback: Tiny supporting phone-cover facts, the pagination cost of the book frame, sequential rather than facing languages on phone, and unobserved page-curl feel and performance keep this below a 9-level experience.
